topic: Adjusting frequency model for campaign data
summary_markdown:
Someone requested that the frequency model for a specific company number (7939) be switched so that the campaign data uses the same model as the traffic dashboard. [me] noted this was not simple but agreed to work on it during the day. To escalate the request, [me] suggested creating a high-priority ticket, although they initially stated it was usually a minor task.
[p1] provided an Atlassian link (DOOH-2115) for tracking.
decisions: The frequency model for company_num 7939 will be adjusted to match the traffic dashboard's model.
action_items: [me] to work on adjusting the frequency model during the day.
[p1] provided ticket DOOH-2115 for tracking the request.
